desc: The USB-557 TUSK EDC offers a compact, versatile solution for your everyday carry needs. A 3-position radial selector allows easy activation of the Turbo, 1,700 Lumen flashlight, a precision green laser, UV floodlight and secure battery safe mode to avoid accidental activation. The USB-557 TUSK EDC is rated IP67 dust and waterproof and features a rubberized side door that opens for direct USB-C charging. The built-in charging indicator turns from red to green when fully charged. Included is a 2 foot USB-C charging cable and lithium-ion rechargeable battery.
